security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately requires an external sonos CLI and local-network access to discover and control speakers. Most scanner hits are Markdown examples or troubleshooting strings, but the unpinned Go installer adds supply-chain risk.

remediation.issue: External installer uses a moving latest version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the Go module to a reviewed tag or commit and update it through normal release review.

remediation.issue: The skill executes local-network speaker commands.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users before changing playback, volume, groups, queues, or favorites on their Sonos system.

static_findings.snippet: Use `sonos` to control Sonos speakers on the local network.
- `sonos discover`
- `sonos status --name "Kitchen"`
- `sonos play|pause|stop --name "Kitchen"`
- `sonos volume set 15 --name "Kitchen"`
- Grouping: `sonos group status|join|unjoin|party|solo`
- Favorites: `sonos favorites list|open`
- Queue: `sonos queue list|play|clear`
- Spotify search (via SMAPI): `sonos smapi search --service "Spotify" --category tracks "query"`
- If SSDP fails, specify `--ip <speaker-ip>`.
- Spotify Web API search is optional and requires `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`.

content.user_title: Control Sonos Speakers from AI Tools
content.value_statement: Managing Sonos speakers from chat can require manual CLI steps. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused Sonos commands and troubleshooting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Discover Sonos speakers on the local network with sonoscli.
Check speaker status by room or speaker name.
Start, pause, stop, and adjust playback through the sonos command.
Set speaker volume for a named Sonos device.
Manage groups, favorites, queues, and Spotify SMAPI searches.
Explain common SSDP and sandbox network errors.
limitations: Requires the external sonos binary to be installed and available.
Requires network access to the same local network as the speakers.
Cannot bypass Codex, Claude Code, Docker, or operating system sandbox limits.
Spotify Web API search requires separate Spotify credentials.

use_cases.title: Home Audio Control
use_cases.description: Discover rooms and adjust playback without remembering sonoscli syntax.

use_cases.title: Support Troubleshooting
use_cases.description: Map common discovery and bind errors to practical local network advice.

use_cases.title: Workspace Speaker Operations
use_cases.description: Check status, group speakers, and manage queues for shared office audio.

prompt_templates.title: Find Speakers
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Sonos speakers on my local network and summarize the rooms you see.

prompt_templates.title: Adjust One Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Kitchen speaker status, then set its volume to 15 if it is available.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Discovery Error
prompt_templates.prompt: I get a no route to host error when discovering Sonos speakers. Explain likely causes and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Shared Audio
prompt_templates.prompt: Review current groups, help me join the Kitchen and Living Room speakers, then inspect the queue.

output_examples.output: The assistant would run Sonos discovery, list detected rooms, and note any network access errors.
The assistant would check the Kitchen speaker, apply the requested volume change, and report the result.

output_examples.input: Why does discovery fail in my sandbox?
output_examples.output: The assistant would explain local network permission limits and suggest direct mode or approved network access.

best_practices: Confirm the target room before changing playback, volume, groups, or queues.
Use speaker names or explicit IP addresses when discovery is unreliable.
Check local network permissions before troubleshooting Sonos discovery failures.
anti_patterns: Do not change shared speakers without user confirmation.
Do not assume Spotify search works without configured credentials.
Do not treat sandbox network errors as Sonos device failures.

faq.question: Does this skill install Sonos software?
faq.answer: The metadata can install the external sonoscli binary through Go when the host supports that installer.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Speaker control mainly needs local network access. Installing the binary or using Spotify features can require internet access.

faq.question: Can it control any Sonos room?
faq.answer: It can target rooms that the sonos command can discover or reach by IP address.

faq.question: Can it work inside a sandbox?
faq.answer: It can work only if the sandbox allows local network discovery and UDP access.

faq.question: Does it store speaker credentials?
faq.answer: The skill file does not store speaker credentials. Spotify API use requires separate user-provided credentials.

faq.question: What tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
